solution_principle:
3- Graph Mapper: Maps a number of values using a function.

- Using Multiple INPUTS:
- Take the previous example and input a seconf value.

- Get a Panel and watch the results.

- Important: The resulting data depends on the order of the values you input. Try to use the "Merge" component to keep track of that order of inputs.

- Use a "Range" of values to input more values.
- Notice that the "Domain" D INPUT of the "Range" component comes with a default domain between 0 & 1.
- Also notive that the default number of steps is 10, illustrated by the N INPUT.

- You can change both the D & N values by contructing a new "Domain" and using an integer slider.

>> Be Careful! If the domain range goes beyond the Graph Mapper's domain, there will be missed output results!
preconditions: If the domain of values is greater than the domain of the Graph Mapper, the Graph Mapper will only affect the values within its own domain.
